item.title: In 1978, New York advocates sought affordable homes; nearly 50 years later, 145-home community is complete
item.description: After more than four decades of hurdles, a housing initiative from Long Island, initiated in 1978, has finally come to fruition with 145 affordable homes at Matinecock Court. This $98 million project overcame extensive legal and political challenges since its inception, which is linked to a pivotal Fair Housing Act case that reached the Supreme Court.

item.title: In 2002, South Australia sank ex-HMAS Hobart in under 3 minutes; 18 years later...
item.description: Having been decommissioned and sunk in 2002, the ex-HMAS Hobart has evolved into a lively underwater ecosystem. This former Australian warship is now home to more than fifty distinct fish species, while its submerged structure nurtures an array of filter-feeding organisms. Located in a safeguarded marine park sanctuary, it offers an enticing destination for divers eager to explore successful efforts in habitat rehabilitation.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Billionaire heiress Isabel Getty, great-granddaughter of J. Paul Getty, marries Faris McKinnon
item.description: Billionaire dynasty heiress Isabel Getty, great-granddaughter of oil tycoon J. Paul Getty, has married British financier Faris McKinnon in an intimate London ceremony. The couple exchanged vows at Chelsea Old Town Hall before celebrating at Harry’s Bar in Mayfair. Isabel and Faris later made a stylish exit in a vintage black Rolls-Royce, accompanied by their young son Viggo.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Australia’s endangered eastern quolls welcome new joeys; after vanishing from mainland for 60 years
item.description: Australia’s endangered eastern quolls are showing signs of recovery after conservationists successfully bred captive-raised animals in Tasmania. One released female has six joeys in her pouch, offering hope for the species’ future. Eastern quolls disappeared from mainland Australia by the 1960s, largely due to habitat loss, disease, road accidents and predation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Ricky Hatton’s mansion, where he was found dead in 2025, sold for £1.5m, £350k below asking price
item.description: Late boxing legend Ricky Hatton’s luxury mansion in Greater Manchester has sold for £1.5 million, £350,000 below its original asking price. The five-bedroom property, where Hatton was found dead in 2025, featured a heated indoor pool, jacuzzi, gym, cinema, games room and Manchester City memorabilia. The sale comes amid reports over his estate.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: "You guys were the issue": FaZe Banks drops explosive truth about FaZe Clan’s end
item.description: During a recent livestream, FaZe Banks candidly discussed the challenges facing FaZe Clan, pinpointing former members like Stable Ronaldo as key contributors to its decline. He revealed an astonishing eleven million dollar investment in creators that yielded no profits, questioning Ronaldo's financial outcomes pre- and post-FaZe membership. These remarks shed light on underlying tensions and disagreements within the organization.

item.title: Game on, history off: White House unveils MAGA arcade
item.description: The White House launched retro-style video games to promote President Trump's agenda. Two immigration games, 'Build the Wall' and 'Rio Run,' sparked significant controversy. Critics argue these games trivialize serious immigration issues and dehumanize migrants. Supporters believe the administration is communicating policy in an accessible language for younger Americans. This initiative reflects a broader effort to reshape America's historical narrative.

item.title: In 1972, Illinois used 246,000 cubic yards of coal fly ash beneath 7,500 feet of expressway
item.description: In 1972, a groundbreaking Illinois expressway project utilized coal fly ash for highway embankment fill, showcasing remarkable structural integrity over time. Vigilant monitoring revealed no concerns with settlement, frost heave, or groundwater. This successful initiative not only prompted other states to adopt fly ash recycling standards but also demonstrated that industrial byproducts can effectively substitute natural aggregates in construction endeavors.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Streamer MoistCr1TiKaL drops first look at Godslap animated movie coming in 2028
item.description: MoistCr1TiKaL has just announced the Godslap animated movie, a captivating adaptation of his graphic novel. This exciting hand-drawn 2D animation project is produced by Lyrical Animation and Meatier Productions, with animation expertly crafted by Powerhouse Animation Studios, famous for their work on Castlevania. Set in a cyberpunk universe, the plot centers around a young hero taking on a formidable corporation. Production is already underway, targeting a 2028 release.

item.title: Mariners raised an American flag after clinching their division days after 9/11; 25 years later...
item.description: In a celebration of unity and triumph, a new bronze statue honors a pivotal moment in Seattle Mariners history. It features two former players hoisting the American flag, capturing the spirit of their victorious 2001 division title. This monument is situated in a modern plaza that includes interactive components and fundraising initiatives, with proceeds dedicated to restoring youth baseball and softball fields across Washington state.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: This vacant California lot is now a refuge from heat waves
item.description: In San Ysidro, California, the newly opened La Semilla Community Resiliency Center stands as a vital resource for local residents confronting climate adversity. This innovative center provides essential cooling during sweltering heat and electricity during power failures. Furthermore, it focuses on educating the community about disaster preparedness and sustainable practices, directly tackling critical environmental problems such as pollution and extreme weather conditions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Meet Kiran Reddy, 18-year-old Georgia teen who became the first Indian American to win Miss Teen USA
item.description: Kiran Reddy has made an outstanding mark as the first Indian American crowned Miss Teen USA. Having previously claimed the Miss Georgia Teen USA title, she is celebrated as Georgia's first national winner. A dedicated pre-medical student, Reddy aspires to inspire young girls. She is set to represent the United States at the Miss Teen Universe contest, alongside continuing her academic journey.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: In 1969, Malcolm Forbes bought Colorado's Trinchera Ranch; 35 years later his family...
item.description: The Forbes family has made a significant contribution to conservation by donating an 80,000-acre easement, safeguarding alpine wilderness in southern Colorado from future commercial development. This groundbreaking agreement marks the largest donation of its kind in Colorado's history, establishing permanent restrictions against subdivision and commercial ventures on the historic Trinchera Ranch. It symbolizes 35 years of dedicated stewardship by the Forbes family towards preserving nature.
